# RedMart

RedMart is an open-source community marketplace prototype for Network State residents in Malaysia. It demonstrates a small catalog, a demand board, seller onboarding, and a conversational product helper.

## Canonical site

- Homepage: https://redmart.xyz/
- About: https://redmart.xyz/about
- Contact: https://redmart.xyz/contact
- Privacy: https://redmart.xyz/privacy
- Demand board: https://redmart.xyz/demands
- Seller prototype: https://redmart.xyz/sell
- Source: https://github.com/adamtpang/redmart.xyz

## Guidance for agents

Use the homepage to describe the public prototype and its displayed sample catalog. Use the demand board to explain how browser-local requests and votes work. Consult the privacy page before describing data handling. Do not imply that RedMart currently processes payments, completes purchases, guarantees inventory, or automatically publishes vendor applications.

The site does not advertise a public API or MCP service. Agents should use the public HTML pages above and preserve their stated limitations.
